objective: Confirm exact-product JNU Micro consistency of the frozen HAR-RSV specification after long-history true-OSE Mini Stage A passed.

source.raw_frequency: source-provided 5-minute primary; source-provided 1-minute measurement QA only
source.cloud_input: non-reconstructive daily RV/RSV derived panel only

models.challenger: HAR_RSV: logRV_t ~ 1 + logRSV+_{t-1} + logRSV-_{t-1} + weekly_logRV + monthly_logRV

stage_b_pass_rule: HAR_RSV full-OOS mean QLIKE loss is lower than HAR_RV
HAR_RSV full-OOS mean MSE loss is lower than HAR_RV
At least one of QLIKE or MSE 5-day block-bootstrap probabilities of positive improvement is >= 0.95
Derived manifest has zero unresolved critical data-quality issues

interpretation.pass: TRUE_JNU_MICRO_STAGE_B_PASS; Stage 3 true-target-data confirmation passes for HAR-RSV. Promote only to INFORMATION_STATE_CANDIDATE / risk-state role, not directional alpha and not Stage 9.
interpretation.fail: TRUE_JNU_MICRO_STAGE_B_FAIL; do not admit the HAR-RSV family as a confirmed JNU module despite Mini Stage A PASS.

forbidden: Change 5-minute sampling after Micro outcome inspection
Use 1-minute QA to choose a different primary estimator
Add leverage/jumps/neural features to rescue a negative Micro result
Use the shorter Micro sample to reinterpret or modify Stage A
Call Stage B PASS directional alpha or Stage 9 validation
